mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right agency for a GEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an agency for a GEO website audit, look for one with demonstrated expertise in local SEO and a clear understanding of your industry. Review their case studies or testimonials to assess their track record with local businesses, particularly those in competitive markets. Ensure they provide a transparent process, detailed reporting, and actionable recommendations rather than just data dumps. A good agency should also be responsive, communicate clearly, and align with your business goals. Prioritize agencies that offer custom strategies over generic solutions, as local SEO needs are highly specific.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an agency with local SEO expertise, relevant case studies, transparent processes, detailed reports, and clear communication, prioritizing custom strategies over generic solutions.
